description: Leave a request in the Squatch Stack inbox: a custom shirt or piece, details or an update on something, help with an order, or anything else. A person reads every one and replies by email when the request includes an address. Returns a reference (SQ-XXXXXX) to check with request_status. It sends no email and charges nothing; the request and any address are kept for 180 days, then deleted. The address is optional and is included only when the person chooses to give it.

about.description: Optional: a product slug or an order reference this is about

contact.description: Optional: the email address the person chose to give for the reply

kind.description: custom = make something; details = more about a product or service; update = news on something already asked; order = help with an order; other

message.description: What they want, in their words: what, how many, by when

name: request_custom
title: Send the studio a request
